methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Pre-Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $500K total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Chips & Semiconductors (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 12 same-sector peers exist in Chips & Semiconductors, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

methods.name: Public-Comp Anchoring
methods.skip_reason: target revenue not on file (private companies rarely disclose)
methods.rationale: Public Semiconductors P/S median is 21.5x across 3 tickers. Cannot apply without target's revenue.

data.narrative:
Photonium is a Pre-Seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Jennifer Song and Adam Mhatre that has raised $500K to date. The comparable universe consists of 3 public semiconductor players (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers including Cerebras, Credo Semiconductor, SambaNova Systems, PsiQuantum, and Etched, though few operate at an equivalent stage.

Stage-Progression anchoring is the sole applicable method here. Using total raised ($500K) as a proxy for enterprise value and applying a standard Pre-Seed to next-stage multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $1.25M. Peer-Median comparison is inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-filter matches within the Chips & Semiconductors sector—while 12 same-sector peers exist, none satisfy adjacent-stage or similar-valuation-tier criteria, making a sector-wide median unreliable. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be deployed absent revenue disclosure, which is typical for private companies at this stage; the median P/S multiple across public semiconductor comps is 21.5x, but this metric is not actionable without Photonium's revenue.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.06M to $1.44M, centered at $1.25M. Key uncertainties include the absence of stage-appropriate private comparables and lack of revenue data that would enable cross-check via public multiples. Any refinement hinges on disclosure of early revenue or customer traction.
